key_points: Salesforce announced acquisition of Listen Labs, an AI-powered customer research platform, driving a ~3% stock increase on Sep 30.
Multiple outlets reported the stock up 2-3% on the same day due to the acquisition news.
Some analysts downgraded CRM, citing lack of clear growth inflection and balanced risk/reward.
Headlines also highlighted security flaws and service outages, raising operational concerns.
Despite the positive move, CRM remains down ~8% over the past year and trades below its historical highs.
